validation_protocol: Online-Mind2Web full 300 · local browser · GPT-4.1 action-history judge · actor T0 · 30 turns; one evaluation per checkpoint
training_protocol: W&B train/task_success_rate and train/task_invalid_rate over all completed training trajectories collected at each iteration, before dynamic-sampling filtering (15 browser turns). training_success_valid = success / (1 - invalid rate): success among valid trajectories, which removes infrastructure incidents (e.g. Gate B iterations 21-24 and 76-77, 42-90% invalid).

matched_iter90_local.protocol: 3 contemporaneous full-300 repeats; local browser; GPT-4.1 action-history; T0; 30 turns

stealth_iter90.protocol: 3 repeats; stealth browser; o4-mini/AgentTrek judge; actor T0.6/p0.95/k20; 30 turns
